definition: I. [ גּוּז ] verb pass over, away (Arabic pass by, over ; Aramaic גּוּז cross , pass away, fail — Qal Perfect גָּז Ps 90:10 Imperfect וַיָּ֫גָז Num 11:31 — pass away , of the life of the aged, Ps 90:10 גָּז חִישׁ ; transitive bring over, subject wind, object quails from sea, Num 11:31 (read perhaps Hiph`il וַיָּגֶז compare Kö i. 442 Di ).
